expo.name: Tumbite Driver

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tumbite uses your location to show the route to the restaurant and the customer while you deliver.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tumbite uses the camera to photograph the order when you pick it up and deliver it, and to take a photo of your ID and your face when you verify your identity.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Tumbite keeps sending your location while you have an active delivery, even with the screen off, so the customer and the restaurant can see where you are.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Tumbite uses your location to offer you nearby orders and to show your route while you deliver.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Tumbite keeps sending your location while you have an active delivery, even with the screen off.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Tumbite keeps sending your location while you have an active delivery, even with the screen off, so the customer and the restaurant can see where you are.

plugins.cameraPermission: Tumbite uses the camera to scan the order code at the restaurant, to photograph the order when you pick it up and deliver it, and to take a photo of your ID and your face when you verify your identity.
